To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the social network analysis and opportunistic networking are two emerging technologies that are capable of bridging the gap between the social and wireless networking divide.

1) social network analysis aided opportunistic communication can be used to improve the connectivity of the cellular networks in the remote rural areas; 2) social network analysis can be used to offload the teletraffic from the overloaded urban cellular networks; 3) social network analysis and opportunistic communication can help disseminate the IoCi efficiently; and 4) social network analysis is capable of improving the performance of the hybrid information dissemination scheme.

we have developed a new family of hybrid networks that can efficiently disseminate information to numerous requesters in the densely populated regions, and can offload the overloaded cellular network in the rural areas.

the information dissemination in the integrated cellular and opportunistic networks, with an emphasis on the social and wireless networking issues.
the design of a novel integrated communication system, which can efficiently disseminate a wide spectrum of information to numerous MUs.

the design and analysis of integrated cellular and opportunistic networks for disseminating the IoCI, for reducing the tele-traffic of cellular networks, for improving the coverage and connectivity of cellular networks, and for reducing the energy consumption of the MUs.

the integrated cellular and opportunistic networks are able to improve the connectivity of the rural areas, to offload the teletraffic of the densely populated areas, and to efficiently disseminate the information of common interests in the densely populated urban areas.
the integrated cellular and opportunistic networks can be used as a powerful tool to disseminate the IoCIs to a large number of MUs.
the integrated cellular and opportunistic networks have a great potential to improve the overall system performance, and to facilitate the efficient dissemination of IoCI.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the social networking aided wireless networking can improve the performance of the cellular network, while the wireless networking aided social networking can enhance the connectivity of social networks.

the integration of cellular networks and opportunistic networks can be beneficial to both the MUs and the service providers, and the performance of the integrated networks can be improved by taking advantage of the social network analysis.

the integrated cellular and opportunistic networks can be utilized for disseminating the IoCI to numerous MUs, for improving the connectivity of cellular network, and for offloading the tele-traffic in cellular networks.

the integrated cellular and opportunistic networks are a powerful tool for disseminating the IoCI and offloading the tele-traffic.

the opportunistic network can be utilized as an efficient complement to the cellular network for disseminating IoCI, offloading cellular traffic and improving the connectivity of cellular network in rural areas.
the opportunistic networking can be a viable solution for the information dissemination of the common interests in general.
